claims: Coachella gates open daily at 11 a.m. for the Friday–Sunday festival.
Coachella's first music sets usually begin around 12 p.m. or 1 p.m.
Coachella festival generally concludes around 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
Coachella festival generally concludes around midnight on Sunday.
Coachella's online YouTube livestream typically starts around 4 p.m. PDT.
For the 2026 Coachella season, gates open ~11 a.m.
For the 2026 Coachella season, first acts ~12 p.m. – 1 p.m.
For the 2026 Coachella season, headliners ~10 p.m. – midnight.
For the 2026 Coachella season, curfew ~1 a.m. (12 a.m. Sunday).
